name: Initial Access - Valid Local Account Logon (Custom)
blast_radius: Creates one synthetic local account with a per-run random password, performs one logon attempt with it, and removes the account in undo. Undo tolerates the account already being absent.
telemetry: Logon event for the synthetic account
detection: Valid account use detection (logon by a newly created local account)

name: Execution - Windows Command Shell (Custom)
blast_radius: Runs one harmless echo command through cmd.exe and checks its output for a marker. No state is created.
telemetry: cmd.exe process creation with a benign echo command
